title: Eggplant and Cheese Dumplings on Chard and Yoghurt
subtitle: fried egg pasta pockets
description: Fried egg pasta pockets filled with roasted eggplant, Georgian cheese and za'atar, served on yoghurt with garlicky sumac chard.

steps.text: Knead the flour, eggs and water in a bowl for about 8 minutes into an even, soft dough. Wrap in plastic and refrigerate for at least 6 hours.

Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a tray with baking paper. Place the peeled eggplants on the tray, brush generously with 1/2 cup olive oil and bake for about 20 minutes until browned and soft. Cool to room temperature outside the fridge.
Mash the eggplants with a fork, add the grated cheese, za'atar leaves, 1 tbsp sumac and salt and mix.

For the chard, heat 1/2 cup olive oil in a pot and fry the garlic for about 1 minute until golden. Add the chopped chard, stir and cook over low heat for about half an hour until soft. Add the lemon juice, 1 tsp sumac and salt and stir.

Roll the cold dough out on a lightly floured surface to 3 to 4 mm thick. Cut ten 12 cm circles, place about 50 g (a heaped tablespoon) of filling in the centre of each, fold in half and press the edges together with your fingers.
Heat oil for deep frying and fry the dumplings for about 4 minutes in total, turning, until golden.
Spoon yoghurt onto serving plates, top with a generous amount of chard and two dumplings each and serve.
